item.title: Daily News Brief — Nov 27, 2026: UK regulator moves to fence DeFi off from retail tokenized stock trades
item.description:
Friday edition covering Thursday, November 26 through Friday morning, November 27, 2026, a light Thanksgiving day led by London, Brussels and Tokyo. The UK FCA plans to require DeFi platforms to be authorized from October 2027 and to bar UK regulated firms from routing retail trades, including tokenized stock orders, to DeFi protocols, citing the Binance theft. At the European Commission's tokenization roundtable, Nasdaq's Roland Chai calls for an optional EU "28th regime" for tokenized securities, discloses a Swedish DLT trading and settlement license application and says Nasdaq is weighing tokenized collateral, while BlackRock's Hannah Winter says tokenized money market funds are being used as derivatives collateral. Bank of Japan Executive Director Kazushige Kamiyama calls for stablecoin reserve regulation and warns that automated collateral calls and 24/7 trading could raise, not lower, liquidity needs. Also: tokenized sterling government debt quadruples, tokenized Treasury and money market funds at $14.1 billion, ESMA's MiCA register overhaul, Sky's staked USDS liquidity squeeze, Zodia Custody's data incident, and what to watch next week.

item.title: Daily News Brief — Nov 26, 2026: Hong Kong puts tokenized bond settlement inside its central securities depository
item.description:
Thanksgiving edition covering Wednesday, November 25 through Thursday morning, November 26, 2026, a lighter day led by Asia and Europe. The HKMA launches the CMU Digital Asset Platform, putting tokenized bond issuance, atomic DvP and 24/7 multi-currency cash-token settlement inside Hong Kong's central securities depository, with HSBC, Standard Chartered, Bank of China Hong Kong, DBS and six other banks as first direct participants, and we look at what a CSD-led model means for DTCC. HSBC, JP Morgan and StoneX complete the first binding trades in the World Gold Council's Pooled Gold Interests and use them as collateral, while new research suggests Eurosystem eligibility could lower yields on tokenized bonds. Senators Warren and Van Hollen ask the SEC to revoke the tokenized securities venue exemption and withdraw Regulation Crypto Assets, and the EBA warns that DeFi could let firms sidestep MiCA. Also: South Korea's bank-majority won stablecoin model and exchange ownership caps, Kaiko's $12 billion of stablecoin redemptions, Swift naming Chainlink and 17 banks on its shared ledger, Ethereum Institutional's platform, a Canton upgrade, an hourly rolling repo on Stellar, and what to watch into December.

item.title: Daily News Brief — Nov 25, 2026: BlackRock opens tokenized money market fund to Hong Kong investors
item.description:
Wednesday edition covering Tuesday, November 24 through Wednesday morning, November 25, 2026, a quieter pre-Thanksgiving day. BlackRock opens its HKD Digital Liquidity Fund, its first tokenized money market fund in Hong Kong, to retail and institutional investors with $100 million in assets, constant-NAV distributing classes and HKDAP stablecoin subscriptions for professional investors. Neuberger Berman's tokenized high-yield and CLO fund HINC becomes borrowable collateral on Aave Horizon, pushing on-chain collateral down the credit curve, while Binance adds five more bStocks tokens as margin collateral outside the US clearing system. In digital cash, Samsung C&T has moved about $180 million on Citi Token Services, Bloomberg examines uneven stablecoin freeze and reissuance practices after the Binance theft, and Payoneer wins conditional OCC approval for a stablecoin trust bank. Also: OKX ICE first-day volume, a Pomerantz investor alert on Securitize, Rialto's Robinhood-led raise, the European Tokenisation Standards Group nomination deadline, the Ethereum Foundation's post-AI security push, the Glamsterdam delay, and what to watch over the holiday weekend.

item.title: Daily News Brief — Nov 24, 2026: ECB opens Eurosystem collateral to DLT Pilot Regime assets from 2027
item.description:
Tuesday edition covering Monday, November 23 through Tuesday morning, November 24, 2026, a lighter day. The ECB's Governing Council agrees to accept assets issued on DLT Pilot Regime platforms as Eurosystem collateral from June 2027, but only when reachable through an eligible CSD link settling in TARGET2-Securities, a decision that keeps central securities depositories at the center of tokenized collateral. CFTC staff let exchanges, SEFs and clearing houses count bitcoin and ether at a 20% haircut and payment stablecoins at 2% toward operating reserves, but not toward the cash and liquid-securities cushion. item.description:
Thursday edition covering Wednesday, November 18 through Thursday morning, November 19, 2026. At the Singapore FinTech Festival, MAS reveals it issued S$100 million of natively tokenized four-week MAS Bills settled in wholesale CBDC with five primary dealers, says its Singapore Dollar Test Network will become an operational utility called SG Digital Ledger, publishes the Guardian Tokenised Collateral Framework, and issues guidance that bearer-style tokens generally don't count as bank deposits. BNY and SWIAT complete a collateral swap and bilateral repo pilot with Standard Chartered, LBBW and DekaBank on securities held at BNY, a new entrant in the collateral mobility race alongside DTCC, Euroclear and HQLAx. item.title: Daily News Brief — Nov 18, 2026: Fed's Waller says central bank money must anchor tokenized markets
item.description:
Wednesday edition covering Tuesday, November 17 through Wednesday morning, November 18, 2026. Fed Governor Christopher Waller tells The Clearing House conference that stablecoins, tokenized deposits and tokenized money market funds will coexist with central bank money at the foundation, endorses netting over universal atomic settlement, and lists unresolved liability questions from lost keys to "zombie chains." Talos, Marex and Broadridge build a workflow to trade and finance DTCC-tokenized Treasuries beyond market hours, while Anchorage Digital and Kalshi Prime launch tri-party bank-custodied crypto margin and the CFTC sets tokenized collateral and margin on its December 15 roundtable agenda. DBS opens direct USDC minting and redemption for institutions, and the World Bank explores USDC disbursements with Citi and Circle. Also: Revolut's four planned blockchain funds, KB Securities' tokenized bond DvP pilot, Securitize on Stellar, Visa's stablecoin-funded Visa Direct pilot, falling stablecoin supply, and Coinbase's Morpho-powered loans reaching New York.

item.title: Daily News Brief — Nov 10, 2026: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle its tokenized stock platform
item.description:
Tuesday edition covering Monday, November 9 through Tuesday morning, November 10, 2026. NYSE picks Avalanche technology for the clearing and settlement ledger of its planned 24/7 tokenized securities platform, keeping matching on Pillar and running settlement on a private, permissioned chain controlled by its clearing affiliate, a design that sets up a clear alternative to the DTC-centered model. item.title: Daily News Brief — Nov 03, 2026: Hong Kong takes tokenized deposits to 24/7 central bank money settlement
item.description:
Tuesday edition covering Monday, November 2 through Tuesday morning, November 3, 2026, a lighter day dominated by Hong Kong FinTech Week. The HKMA moves Ensemble TX to 24/7 settlement in tokenized central bank money with twelve banks and twenty participants, completes trial trades in tokenized Exchange Fund Bills aimed at repo with regulated stablecoins to follow, and Standard Chartered launches tokenized deposits for Hong Kong corporates on those rails, alongside a planned interbank gold token. NYSE signs Broadridge, Computershare, Equiniti and Superstate as transfer agents for its tokenized venue, raising the question of where a tokenized share's golden record lives relative to DTC, while StoneX argues DTCC's launch validates Securitize and tZERO agrees a $350 million SPAC merger. In collateral, Advent agrees to buy Vermeg with ADIA, HKEX clearing houses begin accepting Chinese government bonds as margin, and Consensys unveils a cross-ledger collateral allocation stack. Also: HSBC RedCoin at 50,000 users, Binance's phased recovery and November 4 reserve snapshot, Ghana's stablecoin directive, and what to watch on election day.
